about: Feature-flag registry. Generated by `eos scaffold flags`; yours to edit. `eos ops check` (also in `eos check`) fails on expired flags, release/experiment flags living more than 90 days, missing owners, and flags read in code (flag_enabled / getBooleanValue ...) that are not listed here. Types: release (ship dark, then remove), experiment (A/B, then remove), ops (kill switch, long-lived), permission (entitlement, long-lived). default: the value when nothing overrides it; env FLAG_<KEY> (upper-case, '-' and '.' become '_') overrides per deployment; rollout_percent (boolean flags) turns it on for a stable share of users by targeting key. Why: .eos/packs/ref/ops/feature-flags.md
